title: Do breast-cancer GWAS risk variants have larger predicted methylation effects than matched background variants?
status: PRE-REGISTERED. Written and committed before any GWAS variant was scored. No result existed when this file was created.
motivation: Most breast-cancer GWAS risk loci are non-coding, and the leading hypothesis for how they act is regulatory. If SilentMethyl's variant-effect predictions carry disease-relevant signal, risk variants should show larger predicted methylation effects than variants matched on substitution class, CpG effect and distance to the target CpG. This is a claim about mechanism behind clinical risk, not about clinical utility, and must be described that way.
why_this_cohort_and_not_ClinVar: The ClinVar matched-background test (REQUIREMENTS.md E.2) was run and is uninformative for a structural reason: its 35 held-out variants span only 6 distinct probes, with 25 on a single CpG, giving an effective n of 6. The GWAS cohort has 46 variants across 55 distinct probes with at most 2 per probe, so the pseudoreplication that invalidated the earlier test is absent by construction.

cohort.source: GWAS Catalog, all-associations file, ontology-annotated release
cohort.chromosomes: 8 and 9 only, because those are the held-out chromosomes; variants elsewhere cannot support a held-out claim
cohort.proximity: within 500 bp of a held-out HM450 probe, matching the model's scoreable window
declared_exclusions: variants whose alleles cannot be resolved from Ensembl
variants where the risk allele equals the reference base and no alternate allele is available
variants altering the target CpG itself, which the model cannot score
final n will be lower than 46 after these; the achieved n is reported and the power below is recomputed on it

independent_unit: the PROBE, not the variant. Variants at the same CpG share the window, the context features and nearly all the sequence. All interval estimates cluster on probeID. This is the error that invalidated the ClinVar analysis and it is fixed here in advance.

primary_statistic.definition: count of cohort variants whose matched-background two-sided tail probability is below 0.05, against a binomial null of 0.05

secondary_statistic.definition: mean matched-background absolute-effect percentile against a null of 50, clustered by probe

power_stated_in_advance.statement: A modest true effect (mean percentile around 55) would be missed more often than not. A null result therefore constrains the effect to be smaller than roughly 8 percentile points but does not establish absence. This must be reported as such.

prespecified_confound.concern: GWAS variants sit preferentially in open, active chromatin, while the synthetic background pool is drawn uniformly across held-out probes. A context difference could produce a percentile shift in either direction with no relationship to disease risk.
prespecified_confound.required_check: Before interpreting any result, compare the cohort and its comparators on all nine context features. Report the comparison whatever it shows.
prespecified_confound.reporting_rule: Report the raw percentile AND a context-adjusted estimate. If the two disagree materially, the raw number is not interpretable on its own and the disagreement is the finding.

interpretation_rules_fixed_in_advance.positive: 7 or more hits with binomial p < 0.01, AND the clustered mean percentile above 50, AND no material context confound. Reported as enrichment.
interpretation_rules_fixed_in_advance.suggestive: binomial p < 0.05 but below the 7-hit bar. Reported as suggestive, explicitly not as a positive result.
interpretation_rules_fixed_in_advance.null: neither of the above, with the clustered mean percentile consistent with 50. Reported as null, with the power statement above attached.
interpretation_rules_fixed_in_advance.significant_in_the_opposite_direction: clustered mean percentile significantly BELOW 50. This is a real possible outcome and must not be reported as 'inconclusive'. It is reported as depletion, and the context check decides whether it is interpretable. The ClinVar analysis code omitted this branch and mislabelled such a result; that omission is corrected here.
interpretation_rules_fixed_in_advance.note: These rules are fixed now so that no rule is chosen after seeing the number.

analysis_pipeline.background: the existing 14,996-variant synthetic pool (results/journal/clinvar_matched_background/synthetic_background_pool.csv), built by data/build_synthetic_background.py with random positions and alleles, seed 42
analysis_pipeline.matching: scripts/05_matched_background.py tiered matching on substitution class, CpG effect and distance, unchanged
analysis_pipeline.preflight: data/preflight_clinvar_background.py must report GO before any GPU time is spent
analysis_pipeline.sequence_validation: the reference base read from Healthy_5000bp_DNA at the computed offset must equal the reference allele for every variant; any mismatch halts the build rather than being tolerated
